title: Step 7b - Interpreting Logistic Regression Results: Prediction Regions Explained

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so, what we're going to do now is we're going to get that whole code, you know, from the original file.
cues.zh: 現在從原始檔案取出整段程式碼。

cues.en: We're going to paste it inside our new implementation.
cues.zh: 貼到新的實作中。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And we're going to do the same for the Test set.
cues.zh: 測試集也做相同處理。

cues.en: And then, I will actually try not to show you the Test set now, but let's get the code.
cues.zh: 先不要顯示測試圖，但先取用程式碼。

cues.en: Let's paste that below in a new code cell.
cues.zh: 在下方新增儲存格，再貼上。

cues.en: And now, let's enjoy the results.
cues.zh: 現在欣賞結果。

cues.en: So, what we're going to do is first execute this cell.
cues.zh: 先執行這個儲存格。

cues.en: It's going to take a little while actually because you know the step is 0.25, meaning, we will get a very, very dense grid, as I've just explained.
cues.zh: 可能需要等一下，因為步長 0.25，會產生非常密集的網格。

cues.en: And therefore, you know, the predict method is applied on each of these dense points of the grid.
cues.zh: predict 會對每個密集格點執行。

cues.en: And that's why there are actually a lot, lot, lot of predictions to compute.
cues.zh: 因此需要計算非常多預測。

cues.en: And that's why it's taking a little time.
cues.zh: 所以要花一點時間。

cues.en: But there you go, it's coming.
cues.zh: 不過快出來了。

cues.en: Here we go. So, not that long, that's good.
cues.zh: 出來了，沒有太久，很好。

cues.en: We just got the results of the Training set.
cues.zh: 剛取得訓練集結果。

cues.en: Let's also plot now the results of the Test set.
cues.zh: 現在也畫測試集結果。

cues.en: And then I will make my comments on the results.
cues.zh: 然後我再解釋。

cues.en: All right, so we can just let it run and start by observing and interpreting the results of the Training set.
cues.zh: 讓它繼續跑，先觀察並解讀訓練集。

cues.en: All right, so just to recap, you have to understand four things in this plot is that all the points that you see here, whether they're red or green, are the real customers and the real results
cues.zh: 複習一下，圖中要理解四件事。紅色或綠色的所有點，都是真實顧客，以及訓練集的

cues.en: in the Training set.
cues.zh: 真實結果。

cues.en: The green points correspond, of course, to the customers who bought the previous SUVs.
cues.zh: 綠點是先前買過 SUV 的顧客。

cues.en: And the red points correspond, of course, to the customers who didn't buy any previous SUV.
cues.zh: 紅點是沒有買過的顧客。

cues.en: And then, the other two things to understand is that those colored regions here, you know, this red region and the green region are the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 另外兩件事，是紅色與綠色的整片區域，它們是預測區域。

cues.en: So this region is the region where our model predicts that the customer didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 這區模型預測顧客沒買 SUV。

cues.en: And this region is the region where our logistic regression model predicts that the customers bought the previous SUV.
cues.zh: 這區則預測買過 SUV。

cues.en: And so, in order to figure out where the correct predictions are and the incorrect predictions are, well, the correct predictions are where we have some observation points
cues.zh: 要找正確與錯誤預測，正確的是觀測點

cues.en: with the same color as the prediction region, and the incorrect predictions are where we have some observation points with a color that is different
cues.zh: 和預測區域同色；錯誤的是觀測點顏色不同於

cues.en: than the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 預測區域。

cues.en: For example, this customer here, who in reality bought the SUV, you know, corresponding to 1 here, is actually an incorrect prediction
cues.zh: 例如這位顧客實際買了，對應 1，卻是錯誤預測，

cues.en: because it falls into the wrong region, the red region.
cues.zh: 因為落到錯誤的紅色區域。

cues.en: And vice versa, this customer here, who in reality didn't buy the SUV because it corresponds to 0, well, is the wrong prediction because it falls into the green region where
cues.zh: 相反地，這位實際沒買，對應 0，卻落在綠色區域，

cues.en: customers are predicted to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 被預測會買，所以也是錯誤。

cues.en: And then, finally, what's the most interesting in all this is the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 最有趣的，則是預測邊界。

cues.en: As you understood, the prediction boundary is the boundary between those two prediction regions, you know, the green prediction region and the red prediction region.
cues.zh: 邊界分隔兩個區域，也就是綠色與紅色預測區域。

cues.en: It is where your classifier separates basically the two classes, the class 1 and the class 0.
cues.zh: 分類器在這裡區分類別 1 和 0。

cues.en: And now, you have to understand something very, very important.
cues.zh: 現在要理解非常重要的一點。

cues.en: It is the fact, you know, it is the observation that the prediction curve of the logistic regression model is actually a straight line for one specific reason.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸的預測邊界是直線，有特定原因。

cues.en: It is because the logistic regression model is a linear classifier.
cues.zh: 因為它是線性分類器。

cues.en: For any linear classifier, the prediction boundary or the prediction curve will always be a straight line.
cues.zh: 任何線性分類器，在二維的預測邊界或曲線都會是直線，

cues.en: You know, in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 也就是二維時。

cues.en: In three dimensions, it'll be a straight plan, okay?
cues.zh: 三維則是一個平面。

cues.en: So that's what we get for linear classifiers.
cues.zh: 這就是線性分類器的結果。
